Place the portions skin side down (or up, if you want to eat the skin) in a 28 x 20 cm (11 x 8 inch) baking dish. Set aside.
Sauce: In a small saucepan, bring the wine and shallots to a boil. Reduce until almost dry. Pour in the cream. Salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Add the herbs and cook for 1 minute, stirring.
Add the butter and whisk until melted. Adjust the seasoning. Pour the sauce over the salmon portions. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until the salmon is pink.
Serve the salmon on plates. Drizzle with the sauce and a little lemon juice. Serve with the Herbed Basmati Rice, if desired.

11258.title: Ashley Thornton's Spring Cappelletti in Brodo
instructions: Broth: In a large pot, bring all the ingredients to a boil. Simmer over low heat for 2 hours or until the broth has reduced by half. Skim and remove the fat from the broth, as needed.
Set a fine sieve over another saucepan. Strain the broth. Compost the aromatics. Adjust the seasoning.
Egg Pasta Dough: Meanwhile, in a bowl, mix the eggs, egg yolks and oil with a fork.

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook, combine the flour, semolina and salt. Add the egg mixture and mix until the dough starts to form (see note). Knead the dough for 10 minutes or until smooth. Cover in plastic wrap and let rest for 45 minutes at room temperature.

Filling: Meanwhile, in a small pot of salted boiling water, blanch the peas for 3 minutes. Drain the peas and quickly cool them in a bowl of ice water. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl. Using a fork, mash the peas. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Season with salt. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

On a work surface dusted with semolina, divide the dough into 4 pieces and shape them into rectangles so they go through the pasta machine more easily. Keep the pieces of dough wrapped in plastic wrap.

Using a pasta machine, roll out one rectangle of dough at a time, thinning it gradually (to setting 8 or 9, depending on the machine). Place the rolled-out sheet of dough on a clean, dry wooden cutting board. Cut the strip into sections, as needed. Cut each section in half lengthwise.

Working with one half-strip of dough at a time, place 2.5 ml (1/2 tsp) of filling along the centre, leaving about 4 cm (1 ¼ inches) between each portion of filling. Fold the dough over lengthwise, then press lightly around the filling. Seal the dough by pressing around the filling.

Using a 3 cm (1 1/4 inch) round cookie cutter, cut out the dough with the filling in the centre, taking care to keep the fold of the dough (the straight side). With your fingers, lift the curved part upward while bringing the ends of the fold together and pressing them. You should have “little hats.” Place the cappelletti on a baking sheet dusted with semolina. Cover with a dishcloth to prevent from drying out. Repeat with the remaining pieces of dough. Reuse the scraps and roll them out again, as needed. Freeze at this point, if desired (see note). Refrigerate until ready to cook.
Cooking: In the boiling broth, cook a quarter of the cappelletti at a time for 3 minutes.
Divide the cappelletti and broth among bowls. Sprinkle with Parmesan and drizzle with olive oil.

11261.title: Pan-Fried Asparagus and Shrimp with Quick Preserved Lemon Mayonnaise
instructions: Mayonnaise: On a work surface, cut the lemon into slices 5 mm (1/4 inch) thick. Using a small knife, remove the seeds from the slices, if needed. Compost the ends and seeds.

Place the lemon slices in a small saucepan. Add the salt and sugar. Cover with cold water. Bring to a boil. Cook over high heat until the lemon slices are translucent and the water has almost completely evaporated, about 15 minutes.

In a small blender, purée the still-hot lemon slices with the egg yolk, lemon juice and mustard. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the food processor as needed. Add the oil. Blend until the purée is as smooth as possible. Adjust the seasoning. The mayonnaise keeps for 5 days in an airtight container in the refrigerator (see note).

Asparagus and Shrimp: Meanwhile, place the asparagus in a large skillet. Add cold water halfway up the asparagus. Salt lightly. Bring to a boil. Cook the asparagus until al dente. Set the asparagus aside on a plate. Discard the cooking water. Dry the skillet well.

In the same skillet over medium heat, cook the shrimp in the butter for 4 minutes. Return the asparagus to the skillet. Add the shallot, herbs and Aleppo pepper. Poivrer. Mix well. Continue cooking until the shrimp and asparagus are cooked. Adjust the seasoning. Keep warm as needed.
Spread mayonnaise on a large serving plate. Top with the asparagus and shrimp. Sprinkle with tarragon leaves, Aleppo pepper and lemon zest. Serve immediately.

11301.title: Tres Leches Cake
instructions: Cake: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Butter a 13 x 9-inch (33 x 23 cm) glass baking dish.
In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Gradually add 160 g (3/4 cup) of the sugar and beat until the meringue forms stiff peaks. Set aside.
In a third bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the remaining sugar, the milk and the vanilla. Add the dry ingredients and butter. Mix until the batter is smooth.
Using a spatula, stir one-quarter of the meringue into the batter. Using a whisk, delicately fold in the remaining meringue. Spread the batter out in the prepared pan.

Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until the cake springs back when lightly pressed or a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean. Using a toothpick or bamboo skewer, make several dozen small holes in the cake.

Milk Syrup: In a bowl, combine all of the ingredients. To soak the cake uniformly, gradually pour some of the milk mixture over the centre of the cake as soon as it comes out of the oven. Let the cake soak up all the liquid before pouring the remaining milk mixture over the entire surface of the cake. Let cool completely, about 1 hour. Refrigerate for 2 hours.

Whipped Cream: In a bowl, beat the cream with the sugar using an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Spread over the cake. Sprinkle with the cinnamon. The cake will keep for 1 day in the refrigerator.

11302.title: Grecia's Beef Empanadas
ingredients: precooked or instant yellow or white corn flour
instructions: Filling: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, soften the onion, bell pepper and garlic in the oil. Add the meat. Continue cooking for 5 minutes or until the meat is cooked. Add the tomato sauce and paprika. Salt and pepper. Let cool for 15 minutes.

Dough: Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the water and salt. Add the flour and mix with a wooden spoon for 2 minutes or until the dough is smooth. Knead the dough in the bowl with your hands until it is supple and no longer sticky. Add a little water or flour, as needed, depending on the type of flour used (see note). Let rest for 15 minutes.
On a work surface, cut the dough into 12 pieces. With your hands, shape each piece into a ball.
Empanadas: Preheat the oil in a deep fryer to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with paper towels or place a rack on it.

Using scissors, cut a large resealable freezer bag into two separate sheets. Place a ball of dough in the centre of one sheet. Cover with the second sheet. Flatten the dough into a 14 cm (5 1/2 inch) disc. Remove the top plastic sheet and top the disc of dough with 60 ml (1/4 cup) of the filling. Using the plastic sheet, lift the dough and fold it over to form a half-moon turnover. Press around the edge of the dough to enclose the meat and seal the turnover. Carefully peel the turnover off the plastic. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Set aside upright on a large plate.

Fry 3 empanadas at a time in the oil for 4 minutes or until golden and crisp, turning halfway through cooking. Watch out for splattering. Drain on the baking sheet. Serve the empanadas hot. Serve with hot sauce, if desired.

11303.title: Rosina's Tomatillo Salsa Verde for Enchiladas
instructions: In a saucepan of simmering salted water, cook the chili peppers for 5 minutes or until they change colour. Add the tomatillos and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, without letting their skins burst. Drain the vegetables. On a work surface, remove the stems from the chili peppers.
In a blender, purée the chili peppers, tomatillos, garlic, onion and cilantro with the water until smooth. Season with salt.

In the same pot over medium heat, warm the oil. Pour in the salsa and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Adjust the seasoning. Add the sugar, as needed, depending on the acidity of the sauce. Serve the salsa verde hot with enchiladas. The salsa verde keeps for 1 week in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

11306.title: Beef and Onion Rice Bowls (Gyudon)
instructions: Broth: In a saucepan, bring all the ingredients to a boil. Remove from the heat. Let steep for 15 minutes (see Chef's Secret).
Strain the remaining broth through a sieve set over a large bowl. Set aside 60 ml (1/4 cup) of the broth for assembly. Compost the aromatics.

Beef: In a large skillet, combine the onion, ginger and remaining broth. Bring to a boil. Simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes or until the onion is tender. Add the beef. Stir well to keep the slices from sticking together. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until the beef is just cooked. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Keep warm.

In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, warm the oil. Gently crack the eggs into the pan and cook them on one side only for 2 to 3 minutes or until the whites are set and the edges are lightly golden. Season with salt.
Divide the rice and beef among bowls. Spoon the cooking juices and reserved broth over them. Top with the eggs. Garnish with the green onions and pickled ginger.

11345.title: Apple-Cranberry Muffins
instructions: Muffins: Place the rack in the middle position. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper or silicone liners.
In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda and salt.

In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the brown sugar and sugar. Add the sour cream, milk and oil. Mix until smooth. Stir in the dry ingredients. Add the diced apples and cranberries. Mix well. Spread the batter out in the prepared pan.
Topping: Top the batter with the diced apples, cranberries and cane sugar. Bake for 5 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180 °C (350 °F). Continue baking for 18 to 22 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of a muffin comes out clean. Let cool completely on a wire rack.

11347.title: Angel Food Cake with Strawberries and Maple Cream
instructions: Cream: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over the water. Let bloom for 5 minutes.
In a saucepan, bring the maple syrup to a boil and let it reduce by half. Remove from the heat.
Add the gelatin to the pot and whisk until dissolved. Add and blend in the cream. Transfer to a bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until completely chilled.
Cake: Meanwhile, with the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 165 °C (325 °F).
In a food processor, grind 160 g (3/4 cup) of the sugar with the flour and salt into a fine powder (see note). Add the cornstarch and baking powder. Mix well.

In another bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until foamy (a stand mixer makes this step easier). Gradually add the remaining sugar, beating until stiff peaks form. On low speed, add the lemon juice and vanilla.
Sift half the flour mixture over the meringue and gently fold it in with a whisk until the batter is smooth, without losing its volume. Repeat with the remaining flour mixture.
Spread the batter in an ungreased 25 cm (10 inch) tube pan that is not non-stick.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until the surface of the cake springs back when pressed with your fingers.
As soon as it comes out of the oven, turn the pan upside down on a rack and let cool completely, about 3 hours. Increase the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C).

Roasted Strawberries: In a 20 cm (8 inch) square baking dish, combine all the ingredients. Bake for 25 minutes or until the strawberries are roasted and the cooking juices are thick and syrupy. Let cool for 1 hour.
Assembly: Whip the maple cream with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form.

Run the blade of a knife between the cake and the pan. Unmould. The cake will keep for 3 days, covered, at room temperature. Serve the cake with the maple cream, roasted strawberries and fresh strawberries.

11358.title: Breaded Veal Cutlets with Apple Rémoulade
instructions: Remoulade: In a bowl, combine the apples, celeriac and lemon juice. Add the mayonnaise, horseradish and parsley. Season with salt and pepper and mix well. Set aside.
Cutlets: On a plate, season the cutlets with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, place the flour. In a second shallow dish, lightly beat the eggs. In a third shallow dish, place the breadcrumbs.
Dredge the cutlets in the flour and shake off the excess. Dip the meat in the eggs and let the excess drip off. Press into the breadcrumbs to coat well.
In a large skillet over medium heat, heat 1 cm (1/2 inch) of oil. Cook two cutlets at a time for 1 to 2 minutes per side or until golden brown. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels.
Divide the cutlets and apple rémoulade among plates. Serve with lemon wedges.

11379.title: Pasta with Confit Tomatoes, Spinach and Burrata
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large baking dish, combine the cherry tomatoes, garlic cloves, oil, tomato paste and chili flakes. Season with salt.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the tomatoes are tender and starting to burst.
Remove the dish from the oven. Using a fork, crush the tomatoes and garlic cloves.
Meanwhile, in a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta until al dente. Drain the pasta and return to the pot.
Add the tomato mixture and spinach to the pot. Stir well to coat the pasta. Adjust the seasoning.
Transfer the pasta to a large serving dish. Top with the burrata and drizzle with oil. Serve immediately.

11380.title: Creamy Corn Pasta with Nordic Shrimp and Zucchini
ingredients: fresh or thawed frozen Nordic shrimp
instructions: Sauce: In a small saucepan over medium-high heat, soften the shallot in the butter. Add the corn and cook for 2 minutes while stirring. Add the milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Using an immersion blender or a blender, purée the milk mixture until smooth. Season with salt. Strain through a sieve, if desired.
Pasta: Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the diced zucchini, dill, oil, and lemon zest and juice. Season with salt. Set aside.
Meanwhile, in a pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta until very al dente. Set aside ½ cup (125 ml) of the cooking water. Drain the pasta and return to the pot.

Add the sauce and 60 ml (1/4 cup) of the cooking water to the pot. Continue cooking over medium heat until the pasta is al dente and the sauce starts to thicken slightly. Add the reserved pasta cooking water to thin out the sauce as needed. Adjust the seasoning.
Divide the pasta among four plates. Top with the shrimp and the zucchini topping. Sprinkle with more dill. Serve with lemon wedges.

11381.title: Minh Phat Tu's Tomato and Fried Tofu Stir-Fry
instructions: In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, soften the onion and garlic in the oil. Mix in the tomatoes. Cover and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, until meltingly soft. With a wooden spoon, lightly crush the tomatoes to make a sauce.
Add the fish sauce, soy sauce and white pepper. Season lightly with salt and mix well.
Add the fried tofu and mix gently to coat it with the sauce. Simmer over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes so the tofu absorbs the flavours of the sauce.
Spread the tofu mixture on a large serving plate. Sprinkle with the green onions. Serve with white rice, if desired.

11382.title: Minh Phat Tu's Beef Stir-Fry with Black Bean Sauce
instructions: In a bowl, combine the beef, baking soda and 15 ml (1 tbsp) of the low-sodium soy sauce. Let marinate for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in another large bowl, combine the hot water and fermented black beans. Let rest for 20 minutes.

Drain the black beans and return them to the bowl. Using a fork, coarsely mash the beans. Add the remaining low-sodium soy sauce, the broth, dark soy sauce, rice wine and sugar. Mix well and set aside.
In a large non-stick skillet over high heat, cook the meat in 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the oil for 2 minutes on each side or until nicely browned. Set aside on a plate.
In a third bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in the water.

In the same skillet over medium heat, cook the peppers, onion and garlic in the remaining oil for 2 minutes, stirring. Add the sauce and cornstarch mixture, stirring until the sauce thickens. Adjust the seasoning. Return the meat and its juices to the skillet and toss to coat it with the sauce.
Spread the beef mixture on a large serving plate. Serve with white rice, if desired.

11383.title: Labneh and Artichoke Dip with Poppy Seed Crackers
instructions: Crackers: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Spread the soda crackers on the baking sheet. Using a brush, brush the entire surface of the crackers with the butter, on both sides. Place the crackers right side up. Sprinkle with the poppy seeds and fleur de sel.

Bake for 10 minutes or until the cookies are golden. As soon as they come out of the oven, sprinkle with the sumac. Allow to cool. The crackers will keep for 2 weeks in an airtight container at room temperature.
Labneh: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. Season with salt (see note). Transfer to a piping bag fitted with a plain tip or to a freezer bag.

Artichokes: Drain the artichokes in a sieve set over a bowl. Set the oil aside. On a work surface, very finely chop the artichokes and place them in another bowl with the lemon zest and juice. Season with salt and mix. Add a little of the artichoke oil to thin the dip, as needed (see note). Transfer to another piping bag fitted with a plain tip.

Assembly: Using the bag with the labneh, cover an oval serving plate with lines, leaving about 1 cm (1/2 inch) between each line. Using the bag with the artichoke mixture, pipe lines in the empty spaces. Garnish with the olives and pistachios. Serve the dip with the poppy seed crackers.

11384.title: Chocolate Hazelnut Cookies
instructions: Line a plate or a small baking sheet with parchment paper.
Using a 15 ml (1 tbsp) ice cream scoop, shape 14 balls of chocolate hazelnut spread and place them on the plate. Freeze for 30 minutes or until completely frozen.

Meanwhile, in a small saucepan over medium-low heat, melt the butter. Cook until the butter starts to brown and stops foaming. Immediately pour into a heat-resistant bowl. Quickly pour it through a sieve set over a glass bowl. Let cool for 30 minutes.
In another bowl, combine the flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt.

In a third bowl, combine the cooled butter, brown sugar and sugar with an electric mixer. Add the eggs and mix for 5 minutes. On low speed, add the dry ingredients and three quarters of the hazelnuts (25 g/3 tbsp).
Using a 3-tbsp (45 ml) ice cream scoop, shape the mixture into balls and space them out on a baking sheet lined with a silicone mat or parchment paper.

Press a ball of chocolate hazelnut spread into the centre of each ball of dough. With your hands, close the dough around the spread to enclose it, shaping it back into a ball. Return to the baking sheet. Sprinkle the remaining hazelnuts over the balls of dough, pressing lightly. Refrigerate for 2 hours or freeze at this point, if desired (see notes).
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a second baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.

Arrange the cookies spaced out on the two baking sheets. Bake one sheet at a time for 10 to 12 minutes or until the cookies are set on the outside but still soft in the centre, rotating the sheet halfway through (see note). Remove from the oven and immediately top each cookie with a pinch of fleur de sel. Let cool completely on the baking sheet. The cookies will keep for 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature.

11385.title: Marinated Zucchini and Mortadella Sandwiches
instructions: Zucchini: Off the heat, pour oil into a deep skillet or saucepan to a depth of 2.5 cm (1 inch). Over medium-high heat, heat the oil to 180 °C (350 °F). Line a baking sheet with paper towels.
Fry the garlic slices in the hot oil for a few seconds. Using a slotted spoon, remove the garlic and drain it on the baking sheet.
In the same skillet, fry a few zucchini slices at a time until golden, about 4 minutes (see note). Watch out for splattering. Drain on the baking sheet with the garlic. Let cool.

In a bowl, combine the fried zucchini and garlic with the remaining ingredients. Salt and pepper. The marinated zucchini keeps for 5 days in an airtight container in the refrigerator. It's even better the next day (see note).
Sandwiches: On a work surface, cut the buns in half horizontally without going all the way through to the other side.

Spread the inside of the buns with the ricotta. Top the bottom halves of the buns with the arugula and mortadella slices. Top with the marinated zucchini, about 125 ml (1/2 cup) per sandwich. Close the sandwiches. Cut in half, if desired.

11386.title: Zucchini, Orange and Chocolate Muffins
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with silicone or paper liners.
In a large bowl, combine the flours, baking powder, baking soda and salt.

In another bowl, whisk together the zucchini, sugar, eggs, orange zest and oil. Using a wooden spoon, stir in the dry ingredients. Add the chocolate and combine. Divide the batter among the muffin cups, about 60 ml (1/4 cup) per cup.

Bake for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of a muffin comes out clean and the muffins are lightly golden. Let cool on a wire rack. The muffins keep for 4 days in an airtight container at room temperature.

11404.title: Herbed Chicken Legs and Potatoes
instructions: Butter: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. Season with salt and pepper.
Chicken and Potatoes: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).

Spread the potatoes and onion wedges in a 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9 inch) baking dish. On a work surface, using your fingers, loosen the skin of the legs down to the drumstick, taking care not to tear it. Sprinkle the chicken legs with the salt on each side. Rub each side of the legs with the cut side of the lemon.

Divide the butter under the skin of each leg. Arrange the chicken legs over the potatoes in the baking dish. Salt and pepper. Bake for 1 hour or until the meat easily detaches from the bone and the skin is golden.
Garnish: In a bowl, combine the herbs with the oil. Salt and pepper.
Divide the herb salad over the chicken legs. Serve with the grilled lemon wedges. Serve with the Snap Pea and Halloumi Salad with Basil-Lemon Vinaigrette, if desired.

11428.title: Snap Pea and Halloumi Salad with Basil-Lemon Vinaigrette
ingredients: Little Gem lettuces or 1 romaine heart
instructions: Dressing: In a tall, narrow container, such as a measuring cup, combine all of the ingredients. Salt and pepper. Using a hand blender, purée until smooth.
Cheese: In a small skillet over medium heat, toast the almonds in the oil, stirring frequently with a wooden spoon. Season with salt. Set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet over medium-high heat, brown the cheese, stirring constantly, until crisp. Add the honey and chili flakes. Mix well to coat the cheese. Remove from the heat.

Salad: In a large bowl, toss the radishes, lettuce leaves, snap peas and basil leaves with the vinaigrette. Salt and pepper. Add the almonds and cheese. Mix well. Transfer the salad to a serving bowl. Serve with the Herbed Chicken Legs and Potatoes, if desired.

11429.title: Grilled Beef with Basil Salsa Verde
ingredients: beef shoulder clod or flank steak
instructions: Salsa Verde: In a food processor, chop the basil and parsley leaves, green onions and garlic with the lemon zest and juice and the chili flakes. With the machine running, gradually drizzle in the oil until the mixture is creamy but still slightly grainy. Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the food processor as needed. Add more oil, as needed, until the desired texture is reached. Season with salt.
Beef: Preheat the grill, setting the burners to high. Oil the grate.

Grill the meat for 3 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the steaks, until a thermometer inserted in the centre of the meat reads 57 °C (135 °F). Set the meat aside on another plate. Cover and let rest for 5 minutes.

On a work surface, slice the meat against the grain. Serve with the salsa verde and sprinkle with basil and parsley leaves. Delicious with the tomato and shishito pepper salad with chorizo mayonnaise.

11430.title: Tomato and Shishito Pepper Salad with Chorizo Mayonnaise
ingredients: heirloom tomatoes, various colours, cut into slices ½ inch thick
instructions: Mayonnaise: In a small skillet over medium heat, cook the chorizo in the oil for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove from the heat. Strain the chive oil through a sieve placed over a small bowl. Keep the diced chorizo and the oil separately. Let the oil cool for 15 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the egg yolk, lemon juice, mustard and salt. Add the cooled cooking oil in a thin stream, whisking constantly, until the mayonnaise starts to set. Poivrer. Set aside.
In a small food processor, crumble the diced chorizo. Set aside.
Salad: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
On the baking sheet, toss the peppers with the oil. Season with salt. Roast for 7 to 8 minutes or until the peppers start to blacken slightly.

Spread the chorizo mayonnaise on a large serving plate. Cover with the tomatoes. Season with salt. Add the shishito peppers. Sprinkle with the crispy chorizo and garnish with basil leaves. Perfect with the Grilled Beef with Basil Salsa Verde.

11431.title: Peanut Butter and Strawberry Jam Blondies
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Butter an 8-inch (20 cm) square pan and line with a strip of parchment paper, letting it hang over two sides.
In a bowl, mix the brown sugar, butter, 60 ml (¼ cup) of the peanut butter and the eggs until smooth. Add the flour and salt. Mix until smooth. Spread the batter out in the prepared pan.
Drop spoonfuls of the strawberry jam and the remaining peanut butter over the batter. Using the tip of a small knife, swirl through the toppings and batter to create a marbled effect.
Bake for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of the blondie comes out with a few crumbs attached and not completely clean. Let cool completely in the pan, about 2 hours.
On a work surface, unmould. Cut into 9 squares. The blondies will keep for 5 days in an airtight container at room temperature.

11432.title: Decadent Corn Cereal, Toasted Marshmallow and Caramel Bars
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Butter an 8-inch (20 cm) square pan and line with a strip of parchment paper, letting it hang over two sides.
Spread the cereal on a non-stick baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown, stirring halfway through. Let cool. Preheat the oven to broil.

Using a brush, oil another non-stick baking sheet. Spread the marshmallows on it. Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until golden brown, watching them carefully. Let cool slightly so they are easier to handle.

In a large pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the toasted marshmallows and mix well until smooth. Add the cereal and stir to coat it well with the marshmallow. Spread half the mixture evenly in the pan, pressing to pack it lightly. Spread the dulce de leche over the cereal and sprinkle with the fleur de sel. Add the remaining cereal, pressing to pack it down.
Place the chocolate and oil in a bowl. Melt in the microwave or in a double boiler. Mix well. Spread the chocolate mixture over the cereal. Let cool for 2 hours at room temperature.
Sprinkle with fleur de sel. On a work surface, unmould. Cut into 12 squares. The energy bars will keep for 1 week in an airtight container at room temperature.

11433.title: Rose Simard's Raspberry, Green Tea and Sweet Clover Mocktail
instructions: Place a champagne coupe in the freezer to chill.
In a shaker, using a muddler, crush the raspberries to extract their juice. Add the remaining ingredients, except the flower. Mix vigorously for 1 minute.
Strain through a small fine sieve into the glass. Garnish with the flower.

11434.title: Rose Simard's Clarified Raspberry Vanilla Martini
instructions: In a shaker, using a muddler, crush the raspberries to extract their juice. Add the remaining ingredients, except the milk and ice cubes. Mix vigorously for 1 minute.
Strain through a small fine sieve into a wide-mouth glass jar or a measuring cup that holds about 500 ml (2 cups). Stir in the milk and let curdle for 5 to 6 minutes.

Gently pour the mixture into a sieve or funnel lined with a layer of paper towel set over another wide-mouth glass jar or a 500 ml (2 cup) measuring cup. Let the mixture drip through, without pressing or stirring it, about 1 hour. The strained liquid should be clear and smooth. Repeat a second time if the liquid is still cloudy. When the mixture has completely strained through, transfer it to an airtight container and refrigerate for 1 hour 30 minutes or until well chilled. The mixture keeps for 1 week in the refrigerator.
When ready to serve, place one large ice cube in each of two old fashioned glasses. Pour in the chilled cocktail. For each cocktail, thread a raspberry onto a cocktail pick and place it in the glass.

11435.title: Rose Simard's Tomato and Almond Puff Pastry Tart
ingredients: medium heirloom tomatoes in various colours
instructions: With the rack in the lowest position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
On a floured work surface, roll out the puff pastry to get a 10-inch (25 cm) square. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Using a brush, brush the edges of the pastry with the melted butter. With a fork, prick the entire surface of the dough. Bake for 10 minutes or until the pastry is golden and slightly puffed.
Remove from the oven. Spread the ricotta over the puff pastry. Arrange the tomato slices on top, overlapping them slightly. Salt and pepper. Continue to bake for 12 minutes.
Remove from the oven. Garnish with the almonds. Continue baking for 3 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
As soon as it comes out of the oven, drizzle with honey and sprinkle with tarragon. Sprinkle with fleur de sel and pepper. Slide the tart onto a work surface. Cut into squares and serve.

11436.title: Breaded Chicken Cutlets with Creamy Dill Cucumber Salad
instructions: Cutlets: On a work surface, season the chicken with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, place the flour. In a second shallow dish, lightly beat the eggs. In a third shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs and sesame seeds.

Dredge the cutlets in the flour. Shake to remove any excess. Dip into the beaten eggs, letting the excess drip off. Coat with the breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere. Freeze at this point, if desired (see notes).

In a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook half the cutlets at a time in half the oil (30 ml/2 tbsp) for 4 minutes per side or until golden brown. Drain on a baking sheet lined with paper towels. Keep warm (in an oven preheated to 95 °C/200 °F).
Salad: In a large bowl, combine the sour cream and the lemon zest and juice. Add the remaining ingredients. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide the chicken cutlets among plates and drizzle with honey. Top with the cucumber salad and the soft-boiled eggs. Serve with the lemon wedges.

11437.title: Giant Breaded Chicken Cutlet Sandwiches with Tzatziki
ingredients: homemade or store-bought focaccia, about 25 x 20 cm
instructions: Tzatziki: Over a bowl, grate the cucumber and radishes on the large holes of a box grater. Add the lemon juice and salt. Mix and let stand for 10 minutes.

Drain the vegetables, squeezing them in a sieve or with your hands, and place them in another bowl. Add the remaining ingredients. Season with pepper and mix. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Cutlets: On a work surface, season the chicken with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, place the flour. In a second shallow dish, lightly beat the eggs. In a third shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs and sesame seeds.

Dredge the cutlets in the flour. Shake to remove any excess. Dip into the beaten eggs, letting the excess drip off. Coat with the breadcrumbs, pressing on both sides. Freeze at this point, if desired (see notes).

In a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat, cook half the cutlets at a time in half the oil (30 ml/2 tbsp) for 4 minutes per side or until golden brown. Drain on a baking sheet lined with paper towels. Keep warm (in an oven preheated to 95 °C/200 °F).

Pickled Onion: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the onion and lime juice. Season with salt. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave for 30 seconds. Stir the onion and heat for another 30 seconds. Let cool slightly and drain when ready to serve.

Sandwiches: On a work surface, cut the focaccia in half horizontally. Spread the inside of the focaccia with the tzatziki. Arrange the chicken cutlets on the bottom half of the focaccia. Top with the cucumber rounds, pickled onions and lettuce. Close the sandwiches. Cut into four pieces. Serve immediately.

11438.title: Jana Larose's Ricotta Gnocchi with Cream and Pea Sauce
ingredients: mixed tender herb leaves of your choice
instructions: Gnocchi: In a large bowl, combine the ricotta, egg and oil. Season with salt. Using a wooden spoon, stir in the flour until the dough is smooth.

On a lightly floured work surface, divide the dough into 4 pieces. Shape one piece of dough at a time into a 1 cm (½ inch) thick rope. Using a knife, cut each rope into 1 cm (½ inch) gnocchi. Set aside on a lightly floured baking sheet. Freeze at this point, if desired.
Breadcrumbs: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, toast the breadcrumbs in the butter, stirring, until golden, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool.

Sauce: In the same skillet over medium-high heat, soften the onion and garlic in 15 ml (1 tbsp) of the butter for 2 minutes. Add the wine and reduce by half. Salt and pepper. Add the cream and simmer for 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens.
Meanwhile, in a large pot of simmering salted water, blanch the peas for 1 minute. Using a skimmer or slotted spoon, remove the peas and set them aside in a bowl.

In the same pot of simmering water, cook half the gnocchi at a time. When the gnocchi rise to the surface, simmer for 2 minutes or until tender. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the gnocchi from the pot to a baking sheet. Oil lightly.
In another large non-stick skillet over medium heat, brown the gnocchi in the remaining butter for 6 minutes, stirring a few times.
Add the peas and arugula to the skillet with the sauce. Mix well. Adjust the seasoning. Add the gnocchi and toss to coat them with the sauce.
Serve the gnocchi in shallow bowls. Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs and cheese. Garnish with herbs.

11439.title: Raspberry Cake
ingredients: red liquid or gel food colouring
instructions: Whipped Cream: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over the water. Let bloom for 5 minutes.
In a small saucepan, bring half the cream (250 ml/1 cup) and the sugar to a boil, until the sugar dissolves. Remove from the heat. Add the jam and gelatin. Whisk until the gelatin dissolves.

Strain the cream mixture through a sieve set over another bowl, pressing on the jam with the back of a ladle to extract as much liquid as possible. Compost the residue. Stir in the remaining cream and the food colouring. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until completely chilled.
Cake: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line the bottom of an 8-inch (20 cm) springform pan with parchment paper. Do not butter the pan.
In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Set aside.

In a bowl, beat the eggs with an electric mixer until foamy. While beating, gradually add the sugar. Increase the speed and beat until the mixture turns pale, triples in volume and forms a ribbon when it falls from the beaters, about 7 minutes (a stand mixer makes this step easier). Add the cream and vanilla and beat until smooth.
Sift the dry ingredients over the egg mixture and gently fold them in with a whisk until the batter is smooth but has not lost its volume. Spread the batter out in the prepared pan.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of the cake comes out clean. Let cool completely on a wire rack, about 2 hours.

Syrup: Meanwhile, in a small pot, bring all of the ingredients to a boil until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat. Strain the syrup through a sieve set over a bowl, pressing on the raspberries with the back of a ladle to extract as much syrup as possible. Compost the residue. Let cool.
Assembly: Whisk the chilled cream with an electric mixer until semi-firm peaks form. Transfer into a pastry bag fitted with a large plain tip.
Unmould the cake. On a work surface, cut off the domed top of the cooled cake to level it, as needed. Cut the cake in half horizontally. Place one cake layer on a serving dish.

Using a brush, generously brush the top of the cake with raspberry syrup. Using the piping bag, cover with a layer of whipped cream. Using an offset spatula, smooth out the cream. Using the piping bag, pipe a border of whipped cream around the edge of the cake. Fill the centre with the raspberry jam.

Brush the cut side of the other cake layer with the remaining syrup. Place it on the jam-topped layer, syrup side facing in. Using the pastry bag, completely cover the cake with whipped cream. Using an offset spatula, smooth out the cream.

Cover the cake completely with the raspberries and decorate with lemon balm leaves. The cake will keep for 3 days, covered, in the refrigerator. Let sit out at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving.

11440.title: Thierry-Tri Du-Boisclair's White Fish with Yuzu Sauce Vierge and Glazed Zucchini
instructions: Sauce: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. Season with salt. Let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.

Zucchini: Meanwhile, on a work surface, cut the zucchini in half lengthwise. Using a sharp knife, score the cut side of the zucchini in a fine crosshatch pattern about 5 mm (¼ inch) deep, with the cuts close together.
Place the zucchini on a large plate, cut-side up. Season with salt and let drain for 15 minutes.
Gently press the zucchini with your hands and pat dry with paper towels to remove any excess water.
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).

In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring the sake and mirin to a boil. Reduce by half. Add the soy sauce, sugar, white parts of the green onions, ginger and garlic. Continue cooking for 3 minutes or until the glaze is syrupy. Remove the ginger and garlic clove, then compost them.

In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, brown the cut side of the zucchini in the oil for 3 minutes. Turn the zucchini over, then brush them with the glaze using a brush. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until the zucchini are tender.
Fish: Meanwhile, using paper towels or a clean cloth, pat the fish dry. Salt and pepper.

In another large non-stick skillet over medium heat, brown the fish, skin side down, in the oil for 4 minutes or until the skin is golden brown and crisp. Carefully turn the fillets over and continue cooking for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the fish is cooked, depending on the thickness of the fillets.
Spread the sauce on a serving plate and place the sea bass fillets on top. Arrange the zucchini on another serving plate and sprinkle with the green parts of the green onions.

11442.title: Sheet Pan Pepperoni and Cheese Pizza
instructions: Dough: In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, whisk together the water and yeast. Add the flour and salt, then mix for 5 minutes with a wooden spoon or in the stand mixer fitted with the dough hook. The dough will be sticky.

On a floured work surface, shape the dough into a ball and place in a clean, lightly oiled, large bowl. Cover and let rest for 24 hours in the refrigerator. Freeze after this step, if desired (see note).
Sauce: Meanwhile, with the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the tomatoes, oil, garlic and chili flakes. Season with salt. Spread out on the baking sheet. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the tomatoes are nicely roasted.
Transfer the tomato mixture to the same bowl. Using a fork, crush the tomatoes. Add the basil sprigs and mix. Let cool slightly and refrigerate for 1 hour or until the sauce is completely cooled.
Assembly: Remove the dough from the refrigerator and let it rise in a warm, humid place for 1 hour.
Place the rack in the lowest position of the oven. Preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Oil the sides of the baking sheet and the parchment paper.
On a floured work surface, press the dough out with your fingers into a rectangle. Place the rolled-out dough on the baking sheet. Let rest for 30 minutes.
With your fingertips, press the dough from the centre out until it completely covers the bottom of the baking sheet.
Remove the basil sprigs from the tomato sauce and compost them. Spread the sauce over the dough. Sprinkle with the cheese and pepperoni.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the crust is golden and crispy. Slide the pizza onto a work surface. Cut into squares and serve right away with the Bitter Greens Salad, if desired.

11443.title: Bitter Greens Salad
ingredients: bitter salad greens of your choice
instructions: Breadcrumbs: In a small skillet over medium-high heat, heat the oil with the garlic. Add the breadcrumbs and cook, stirring, until golden, about 3 minutes. Remove and compost the garlic. Add the red pepper flakes. Season with salt and mix. Transfer to a bowl.
Dressing: In a tall, straight container such as a measuring cup, blend all the ingredients with an immersion blender. Salt and pepper. Transfer to a large bowl (see note).
Salad: Add the greens to the bowl with the vinaigrette. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat the leaves well with the vinaigrette.
Transfer the salad to a large serving dish. Sprinkle with the crispy breadcrumbs and generously with Parmesan. Serve immediately. Perfect with the Sheet Pan Pepperoni and Cheese Pizza.

11444.title: Braised Chicken and Cheese Tacos (Quesabirria)
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a Dutch oven or ovenproof pot over medium-high heat, brown half the chicken thighs at a time in half the oil (15 ml/1 tbsp). Season with salt. Set aside on a plate.

In the same pot, soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil. Add the dried chilies and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring. Add the broth, tomatoes and vinegar. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes or until the chilies are tender. Remove from the heat.

Using an immersion blender, purée the sauce in the pot until smooth. Add the remaining ingredients. Return the chicken to the pot. Cover and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes or until the chicken falls apart easily with a fork.
Remove the chicken from the pot and place it in a bowl. Using a fork, coarsely shred the chicken. Remove the cinnamon stick and bay leaves from the sauce, then compost them. Adjust the seasoning.

11445.title: Mango Lemonade
instructions: In a blender, purée the mango cubes and sugar with the coconut water and lime juice until smooth. Pour into a pitcher. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Divide the ice cubes and lemonade among glasses. Garnish the glasses with lime slices, mango slices and mint leaves. Delicious with the Braised Chicken and Cheese Tacos (Quesabirria).

11446.title: Colombe St-Pierre's Festive Pad Thai
instructions: Candied Shiitakes: In a saucepan, combine the brown sugar, shiitakes, water, tamari, garlic, ginger and chili pepper. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes or until the liquid has reduced by two thirds and is syrupy. Remove the ginger slices and garlic cloves, then compost them. Drain the shiitakes in a sieve set over a bowl. On a work surface, thinly slice the shiitakes. Set aside the glaze and mushrooms separately.
Nam Phrik Sauce: Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the green parts of the green onions with the remaining ingredients until the brown sugar dissolves.

Pad Thai: Place the pork tenderloins in a rectangular container. Season the meat on all sides with salt and pepper. Take 60 ml (¼ cup) of the nam phrik sauce and coat the meat well with it. Cover and let marinate for 1 hour or overnight.
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a bowl, combine the vegetable oil and sesame oil with the ginger and garlic. Set aside.
Soak the rice noodles in a large bowl of lukewarm water for 15 to 20 minutes to rehydrate them. Drain the noodles and oil lightly, as needed. Set aside.

Remove the pork tenderloins from the marinade, reserving the marinade. Lightly pat the meat dry. In an ovenproof skillet over high heat, brown the pork tenderloins on all sides in 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the oil mixture, without the aromatics. Deglaze with the marinade and let it reduce completely. Add 75 ml (⅓ cup) of the reserved candied shiitake glaze. Turn the tenderloins in the glaze to coat them well.
Bake for 8 to 9 minutes, turning the meat halfway through cooking. Place the tenderloins on a rack. Cover with aluminum foil and let rest for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a wok over high heat (see note), heat 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the oil mixture, without the aromatics. Add a third of the noodles at a time and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until they start to brown. Using tongs, remove the noodles and set them aside on a large serving plate.

In the same wok over medium-high heat, cook the eggs in 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the oil mixture, without the aromatics, stirring constantly with a spatula until the eggs start to set, about 1 minute. Season with salt. Spread the omelette over the noodles on the plate.
In the wok, soften the onion in 60 ml (¼ cup) of the oil mixture, with the aromatics. Add the cabbage and continue cooking until tender. Spread the vegetables over the omelette on the plate.
Assembly: Top the vegetables on the plate with the reserved candied shiitakes, the bean sprouts and cashews.

On a work surface, slice the pork. Arrange the meat over the vegetables on the plate. Garnish with the white parts of the green onions and the herbs. Drizzle with a little of the candied shiitake glaze (see note). Serve with the remaining nam phrik sauce.

11447.title: Lesley Chesterman's Double Chocolate Tart
instructions: Crust: In a food processor, combine the flour, icing sugar and salt. Add the butter and pulse for a few seconds at a time until the butter is the size of peas. Add the egg yolks, water and vanilla. Pulse again until the dough just begins to form. Using your hands, form the dough into a disc. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.

On a lightly floured work surface, roll out the disc of dough to a thickness of 3 mm (⅛ inch). Line a 25 cm (10 inch) tart pan with a removable bottom with the dough (see note). Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until firm.
Meanwhile, with the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).

Cover the dough with aluminum foil, then fill with dried peas or ceramic pie weights. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes. Remove the beans and foil. Bake for 4 minutes or until the pastry is nicely golden. Set aside on a wire rack. Reduce the oven temperature to 325°F (165°C).
Chocolate Cream: Place the chocolate in a large bowl. Set aside.
In a small saucepan over medium heat, heat the cream and milk with half the sugar (55 g/¼ cup) until it comes to a first boil and the sugar is dissolved.
Meanwhile, in another bowl, whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar.
Pour half the hot cream mixture into the bowl with the eggs, whisking. Set aside.
Pour the remaining hot cream mixture over the chocolate and let stand for 1 minute without stirring. Whisk until smooth.
Whisk the chocolate mixture into the bowl with the eggs. If there are any lumps, strain the chocolate cream through a sieve set over a bowl.
Gently spread the chocolate cream over the crust, leaving 1 cm (½ inch) free at the top (room to pour the ganache after baking and cooling).
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the filling is set. Let cool completely on a wire rack, about 2 hours.
Ganache: Meanwhile, place the chocolate in a bowl.
In a small pot, bring the cream to a boil. Pour over the chocolate and let sit for 2 minutes without stirring. Whisk until the ganache is smooth.

Spread the ganache over the cooled chocolate cream. Let stand for about 2 hours at room temperature or until the ganache is set. The tart will keep for 4 days, covered, in the refrigerator. Let sit out at room temperature before serving. Serve with vanilla ice cream, if desired.

11448.title: Brie or Blue Cheese Sandwiches with Apple Chutney
ingredients: kaiser buns or other white buns
instructions: Chutney: In a saucepan, bring all the ingredients to a boil. Poivrer. Simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes or until the liquid is almost syrupy, stirring frequently. Transfer to a bowl and let cool. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. The chutney keeps for 2 weeks in the refrigerator.
Honey Walnuts: In a small bowl, combine the walnuts and honey.

Sandwiches: Spread the inside of the buns with the mayonnaise. On the bottom half of each bun, add the cheese, prosciutto slices, chutney, honey walnuts and greens. Close the sandwiches. Cut in half and serve.

11449.title: Feta and Olive Checkerboard
instructions: In a bowl, place the feta and cover with cold water. Let soak for 10 minutes to reduce the salt. Drain and pat dry.
On a work surface, cut the feta into 30 large cubes. Set aside.

Cut the cucumber in half crosswise. Using a mandoline or vegetable peeler, slice thin strips from each side of the seedy centre of the cucumber to make ribbons. Save the centre for another use. Place the cucumber ribbons in another bowl. Add the salt and toss gently. Let degorge for 5 minutes. Drain and return to the same bowl. Add oil and mix.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the onion with the lemon juice. Let marinate for 5 minutes. Drain.

Line a 23 cm (9 inch) serving plate with the cucumber ribbons, overlapping them. Arrange the feta cubes in a checkerboard pattern in the centre of the plate. Fill the empty spaces with the olives. Cover and refrigerate at this point, if desired. Garnish with the onion, oregano, lemon zest and mint leaves. Drizzle with olive oil.

11450.title: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Sauce: In a bowl, combine all the ingredients. Set aside.
Rice: In another bowl, beat the eggs.
In a large, deep non-stick skillet or wok over high heat, cook the eggs in 15 ml (1 tbsp) of the oil, breaking them up with a wooden spoon, until golden. Season with salt. Set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, cook the shrimp in 15 ml (1 tbsp) of the oil for 1 minute per side or until just cooked. Season with salt. Set aside on the plate with the eggs.
In the same skillet, reheat the rice with the sauce in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until lightly golden. Add the bean sprouts and peas. Cook for 2 minutes.
Return the eggs and shrimp to the skillet. Add the green onions and basil leaves. Continue to cook for 1 minute while stirring. Adjust the seasoning.
Divide the fried rice among bowls. Serve with lime wedges. Serve immediately.

11452.title: Sheet Pan Red Curry Pork Meatballs with Peanut Sauce
ingredients: red, orange or yellow bell peppers
instructions: Vegetables: Place the rack in the middle position. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
On the baking sheet, toss the sweet potatoes and peppers with 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the oil. Season with salt. Bake for 10 minutes.
Remove from the oven. Stir the vegetables. Nestle the meatballs among the vegetables. Continue to bake for 12 minutes.
In a bowl, coat the bok choy with the remaining oil. Season with salt.
Remove from the oven. Spread the bok choy on the baking sheet. Continue baking for 8 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and the meatballs are cooked and golden.

Peanut Sauce: Meanwhile, in a bowl or glass measuring cup, combine all the ingredients. Cook the sauce in the microwave for 1 minute. Stir and continue cooking for 1 minute. Season with salt. Transfer to a small serving bowl. Sprinkle with more peanuts.
Serve the meatballs and vegetables with the sauce. Serve with rice, if desired.

11453.title: Red Curry Pork Meatballs
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line two baking sheets with silicone mats or parchment paper.

In a large bowl, combine the milk, eggs and breadcrumbs. Let soak for 5 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients except the oil and mix well with your hands. The mixture will be soft. Cover and let rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour if the mixture is too soft (see note).

Using a 30 ml (2 tbsp) ice cream scoop, shape the pork mixture into balls and finish shaping them with lightly oiled hands. Divide the meatballs among the baking sheets. Freeze at this point, if desired (see note).
Using a pastry brush, cover the meatballs with the oil. Bake one sheet at a time for 18 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked and golden, turning them halfway through.

11454.title: Red Curry Pork Meatball Soup with Lemongrass and Coconut Milk
instructions: Soak the noodles in a large bowl of cold water for 30 minutes, stirring a few times (see note). Drain the noodles.
Meanwhile, in a large saucepan over high heat, brown the mushrooms in half the oil (15 ml/1 tbsp). Season with salt. Set aside on a plate.
In the same saucepan over medium-high heat, brown the lemongrass, garlic and ginger in the remaining oil. Add the broth and coconut milk. Season with salt. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.

Strain the remaining broth through a sieve set over a large bowl. Compost the aromatics. Return the broth to the saucepan. Stir in the lime juice and fish sauce. Bring to a boil. Adjust the seasoning.
Divide the noodles, mushrooms, meatballs and broth among bowls. Garnish with cilantro leaves and lime wedges.

11455.title: Homemade Fruit Sprinkles
instructions: Line two baking sheets with silicone mats or parchment paper.
In a bowl, using an electric mixer on low speed, mix the icing sugar, water and corn syrup for 1 minute or until the mixture forms soft peaks. Add a few drops of water or icing sugar as needed.

Divide the icing among small bowls. To each bowl, add 15 ml (1 tbsp) of fruit powder (see note) and mix well to get a bright colour. Cover the bowls while you continue with another flavour or colouring.

Working with one colour of icing at a time, use a pastry bag fitted with a very small plain tip to trace lines quite close together on one of the baking sheets. Repeat with the other colours of icing on this baking sheet, then on the other baking sheet, to cover them completely.

Let the icing dry out for 6 hours or until the lines of icing easily come away from the silicone mats or parchment paper. Break the lines of icing into little sprinkle pieces. Perfect for decorating the Giant Berry Tart or any other dessert of your choice. The sprinkles keep for 1 month in an airtight container at room temperature.

11456.title: Giant Berry Tart
ingredients: homemade fruit sprinkles or store-bought sprinkles
instructions: Fruit Garnish: In a saucepan off the heat, combine the sugar and cornstarch. Add the pressed fruits and lemon juice. Mix well. Bring to a boil and simmer for 8 minutes or until the mixture thickens. Transfer to a bowl. Cover the surface of the fruit filling directly with plastic wrap and let cool slightly. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until the mixture has completely chilled.

Dough: Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the flour and salt. Using your fingertips, incorporate the butter into the flour until flaky. Gradually add the water and vinegar. Combine just until the dry ingredients are moistened, making sure to leave pieces of butter intact. The dough will be soft and sticky.

On a floured work surface, roll the dough out to form a 13 x 8-inch (33 x 20 cm) rectangle. With a pastry brush, remove any excess flour. Fold the dough in three crosswise. Fold the dough in half lengthwise to form a square. Cut the dough in half and wrap it in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 45 minutes or until firm.
Cheese Filling: In a bowl, beat the cream cheese with the sugar and egg yolk using an electric mixer until smooth. Set aside.
Egg Wash: In a bowl, combine the egg white and sugar. Set aside.
Assembly: Place the rack in the middle position. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
On a lightly floured work surface, roll out each piece of dough into a 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9 inch) rectangle.

Place a square on the baking sheet. Spread the cheese filling in the centre of the dough, leaving a 2.5 cm (1 inch) border on all sides. Spread the fruit filling over it, leaving a 5 cm (2 inch) border.

Using a brush, moisten the bare border of the dough with egg white. Top with the second crust. Seal the two sheets of dough together by pressing with a fork. Brush the top of the tart with egg white. Using a paring knife, cut 4 small slits in the top so steam can escape during baking.
Bake for 40 minutes or until the crust is golden. Let cool slightly on the baking sheet for 1 hour.
Icing: In a bowl, combine the icing sugar, water and fruit powder. Spread the icing over the tart. Sprinkle with the sprinkles.
On a work surface, cut the tart into squares.

11457.title: Crispy Pork Tonkatsu with Cabbage Salad
instructions: Coleslaw: In a large bowl, combine all of the ingredients. Set aside.

Sauce: In a saucepan off the heat, combine the pear, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, honey, soy sauce and onion powder. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until the sauce thickens, stirring. Add the sesame seeds. Set aside.
Pork: In a shallow dish, place the flour. In a second shallow dish, lightly beat the eggs. In a third shallow dish, place the breadcrumbs.
On a plate, salt the chops on each side.
Dredge the chops in the flour. Shake to remove any excess. Dip the meat in the beaten eggs and let the excess drip off. Press into the breadcrumbs to coat well.
In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, heat the oil. Brown half the chops at a time for 2 to 3 minutes per side. Add more oil as needed. Drain on a plate lined with paper towels.
On a work surface, cut the chops into slices about 2.5 cm (1 inch) thick.
Divide the meat mixture among four plates. Top with tonkatsu sauce. Serve with the cabbage salad and white rice, if desired (see note).

11458.title: Japanese Curry Sauce
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, cook the onions in the oil for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown and caramelized.

Add the pear, garlic and ginger. Continue cooking for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until fragrant. Add the broth and soy sauce. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat, cover and simmer over low heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, in another saucepan over medium-low heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring constantly, until you have a golden to light brown roux. Add the curry powder, garam masala and cumin. Cook over very low heat for 1 minute to toast the spices without burning them. Remove from the heat.
Whisk the roux into the saucepan with the broth. Simmer over very low heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until the curry thickens, darkens, turns glossy and coats the back of a spoon.
Divide the rice and Japanese curry sauce among plates. Top with the crispy pork tonkatsu. Sprinkle with the green onions.

11459.title: Egg and Bacon Toasts
instructions: In a pot of simmering water, cook the eggs for 7 minutes. Using a skimmer or slotted spoon, remove 4 of the eggs from the saucepan and plunge them into a small bowl of ice water. Continue cooking the other eggs for 3 minutes. Remove them and plunge them into another bowl of ice water. Let cool for 15 minutes. Peel, rinse and pat dry the eggs, keeping the two batches separate. Compost the shells.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown the bacon for 8 minutes or until crisp. Using a slotted spoon, remove the bacon from the skillet and set it aside on a plate lined with paper towels. Set aside the skillet and bacon fat.

On a work surface, cut in half the 8 eggs that cooked for 10 minutes. Place the egg yolks in a third bowl and finely mash them with a fork. Add the mayonnaise and mustard. Salt and pepper. Mix until smooth.
Finely chop the egg whites and add them to the egg yolk mixture. Add the bacon and mix well. Adjust the seasoning.
Cut the last 4 eggs into quarters.
In a fourth bowl, combine the herbs, oil, and lemon zest and juice. Salt and pepper. Set aside.
In the same skillet over medium-high heat, toast the bread slices on each side in the cooking fat. Add more oil as needed.
Arrange the toasted bread slices on the work surface. Spread the egg mixture over them. Top with the soft-boiled egg quarters. Salt and pepper. Garnish with the herb salad.

11460.title: Vanilla Peach Compote
instructions: Using a paring knife, make a shallow X-shaped incision at the base of each peach (see note).

In a large pot of boiling water, blanch the peaches until the skin starts to crack, about 15 seconds. Using a slotted spoon, quickly plunge the peaches into a bowl of ice water, then quickly drain them on a plate. Peel the peaches with your fingers or a paring knife. Discard the cooking water.

On a work surface, pit the peaches and dice them. Return to the saucepan. Add the remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil and simmer gently over medium-low heat for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cooking juices are syrupy, stirring frequently. Remove and compost the vanilla pod.

Transfer the peaches to a bowl and let cool slightly. Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours or until the compote is completely cooled. The stewed blueberries will keep for 2 weeks in an airtight container in the refrigerator. This compote is a wonderful topping for the Caramelized Honey, Whipped Ricotta and Peach Toasts.

11461.title: Caramelized Honey, Whipped Ricotta and Peach Toasts
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
In a bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar, honey and salt.
Spread both sides of the bread slices with the butter mixture. Spread out on the baking sheet.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, turning halfway through, until the bread slices are nicely caramelized. Let cool.

11462.title: Carrot Pecan Loaf
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Butter a 9 x 5-inch (23 x 13 cm) loaf pan and line with a strip of parchment paper, letting it hang over two sides.
In a saucepan of boiling water, cook the carrot rounds for 10 minutes or until very tender. Drain the carrot.
In a small food processor, purée the carrot rounds with the brown sugar, oil and eggs until smooth. Using a spatula, scrape down the sides of the food processor as needed.

In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, spices and salt. Add the carrot purée and whisk until smooth. Add the grated carrot, pecans and pineapple. Mix well. Spread the batter out in the prepared pan.
Bake for 55 to 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre of the cake comes out clean. Let cool on a wire rack. Unmould and cut into slices.

11463.title: Carrot Cake Ice Cream
instructions: Ice Cream: In a saucepan, bring the milk, cream, sugar, corn syrup and spices to a boil. Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes.

Place the cornstarch in a large bowl. Pour in a little of the hot milk mixture, whisking. Add the cream cheese and stir until smooth. Add the remaining milk mixture and mix well. Return to the saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat until the mixture comes to a first boil and thickens, stirring constantly and scraping the bottom and sides of the saucepan.
Strain through a sieve set over a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap directly on the surface. Let cool and refrigerate for 4 hours.

Carrots: Meanwhile, in a small saucepan over medium-high heat, bring all the ingredients to a boil. Simmer for 8 minutes or until the liquid has completely evaporated. Transfer to a bowl and let cool. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour. Wash out the pot.

Pecans: Meanwhile, in the small saucepan, bring the brown sugar and water to a boil. Add the pecans and stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the sugar becomes grainy and coats the nuts. Add the pinch of salt. Spread the pecans on a plate and let cool completely.
Pour the milk mixture into the ice cream maker. Churn for 20 minutes or according to the manufacturer's instructions, until the ice cream is set.

Transfer half the ice cream to an airtight container. Add half the pecans and half the carrots. Using a spoon, swirl gently with small circular motions. Repeat with the remaining ice cream, pecans and carrots. Cover and freeze for 1 hour or until the ice cream is firm. Let sit out at room temperature for a few minutes before serving as needed.

11464.title: Mushroom, Sausage and Rapini Lasagna
ingredients: mild or spicy Italian sausages, casings removed
instructions: Sauce: In a food processor, coarsely chop a third of the white mushrooms and shiitakes at a time. Set aside in a bowl and add the oyster mushrooms.
In a food processor, chop the onions and garlic cloves. Set aside in another bowl.
In a large pot over high heat, brown a third of the mushroom mixture at a time in 15 ml (1 tbsp) of the oil. Add more oil as needed. Set aside on a plate.
In the same pot, cook the sausage meat in 15 ml (1 tbsp) of the oil, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until golden brown. Set aside on the plate with the mushrooms.

In the same pot, cook the ground beef in the cooking fat, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, for 6 to 8 minutes or until it starts to brown. Add the onion mixture and anchovies. Continue cooking for 5 minutes or until the onions are translucent, stirring a few times. Season lightly with salt and generously with pepper.

Add the tomato paste and continue cooking for 3 to 4 minutes or until well caramelized, stirring a few times. Add the wine and let reduce until almost dry. Return the mushrooms and sausage to the pot. Add the broth, bay leaves, Parmesan rind and chili pepper. Mix well. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes or until the sauce thickens and reduces to about 2 litres (8 cups). Adjust the seasoning.

Béchamel: Meanwhile, in a pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute while whisking. Add the milk. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Continue to cook for 2 minutes or until the sauce thickens. Remove from the heat. Stir in the Parmesan. Season lightly with salt and pepper. Keep warm.

Vegetables: Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the rapini in the oil for 2 minutes. Add the spinach and garlic. Continue cooking until the spinach is wilted and the rapini is tender. Salt and pepper. Keep warm. Drain as needed.
Lasagna: Meanwhile, in a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the noodles until al dente. Drain the pasta. Coat the noodles in oil and spread out on a baking sheet.
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Assembly: In a deep 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9 inch) baking dish that holds 3 litres (12 cups), spread 125 ml (½ cup) of the sauce. Cover with a layer of about 4 noodles (see note).
Spread 625 ml (2 ½ cups) of the sauce over them. Cover with another layer of pasta.
Spread half the béchamel (430 ml/1 ¾ cups) over it. Spread half the rapini mixture over it. Sprinkle with 100 g (1 cup) of the mozzarella. Cover with another layer of pasta.
Repeat these two steps with the remaining ingredients, ending with a layer of noodles, the remaining sauce, the remaining mozzarella and the Parmesan. Place the baking dish on a baking sheet.
Bake for about 40 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown. Let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

11465.title: Colombe St-Pierre's Brioche Boston Cream Cake
instructions: Brioche: Pour the lukewarm water into a small bowl and stir. Sprinkle in the yeast and mix well. Let rest for 5 minutes.
In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the flour, sugar and candy cap powder. Pour in the beaten eggs and the yeast mixture. Using the dough hook, mix at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Gradually add the butter. Increase the speed and knead the dough for 5 to 6 minutes or until smooth and sticky.
Place the dough in a clean and lightly oiled bowl. Return the dough to coat with the oil. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Let the dough rise in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight.

Sugared Almonds: Meanwhile, in a saucepan, bring the maple syrup and almonds to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the syrup becomes grainy and coats the pecans, about 3 minutes. Add nutmeg and mix. Spread the almonds on a baking sheet lined with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Let cool completely.
On a work surface, cut half the almonds in half. Coarsely chop the remaining almonds and set aside separately.

Pastry Cream: Meanwhile, in a small saucepan off the heat, whisk together the sugar and cornstarch. Add the egg yolks and mix well. Stir in the milk, cream and sweet clover extract. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly and scraping the bottom and sides of the pot, just until the mixture thickens. Remove from the heat. Stir in the butter. Strain through a sieve set over a bowl to remove any lumps.

Cover with plastic wrap directly on the surface of the cream. Let cool slightly and refrigerate for 2 hours or until the pastry cream is completely cooled. When ready to use the pastry cream, mix with a spatula until creamy and smooth. Transfer to a pastry bag fitted with a plain tip.

Assembly: In a small bowl, combine the flour and candy cap powder. Butter the side of a 20 cm (8 inch) springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. Dust the side of the pan with the flour mixture. Spread the halved almonds over the bottom of the pan.

On a lightly floured work surface, knead the dough for 1 minute. Shape it into a 20 cm (8 inch) disc. Place the dough in the pan over the almonds. Cover and let rise in a warm, humid place for 2 hours or until the brioche has doubled in volume.
With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).

Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the brioche is golden brown. Reduce the oven temperature to 150 °C (300 °F) and continue baking for 10 minutes. Let cool for 15 minutes. Unmould and let cool on a rack for 2 hours or until completely cooled.
Using the handle of a wooden chopstick, poke 4 to 5 holes horizontally into the side of the brioche to make a cavity inside. Using the piping bag, fill the brioche with the pastry cream.
Caramel: Place ice cubes in a large metal bowl and pour in cold water.

In a small saucepan over medium heat, heat all the ingredients except the flowers, without stirring, until the caramel is light amber. Remove from the heat, then set the bottom of the saucepan in the bowl of ice water to stop the caramel from cooking. Let the caramel cool slightly. Remove the pot from the ice water.
Place the rack with the brioche on a baking sheet. Using a spoon, pour a little caramel over the brioche. Be careful as the caramel will still be slightly hot.

Line another baking sheet with parchment paper. Dip a fork in the slightly runny caramel and let it drizzle onto the baking sheet to make spun sugar. If the caramel becomes too stiff, warm over medium heat for a few minutes until runny (do not bring to a boil).
Garnish the cake with the spun sugar. Sprinkle with the chopped almonds and decorate with flowers.

11466.title: Squash Pasta with Brown Butter and Ricotta
instructions: With the rack in the middle position, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
On a parchment-lined baking sheet, coat the squash, shallots and garlic with 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the oil. Salt and pepper. Bake for 15 minutes or until the squash is tender.

Meanwhile, in a small non-stick skillet over medium heat, heat the remaining oil. Add the almonds and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until golden, stirring often with a wooden spoon. Season with salt. Set aside in a small bowl until ready to serve. Wash out the skillet.

In the same small skillet over medium heat, melt the butter. Cook until the butter starts to brown and stops foaming. Immediately pour into a heat-resistant bowl. Quickly pour into a glass bowl. Add the lemon juice.
Meanwhile, in a large pot of salted boiling water, cook the pasta until very al dente. Set aside 1 cup (250 ml) of the cooking water. Drain the pasta.
In a blender, purée the roasted squash cubes, shallots and garlic with the broth and harissa until smooth. Season with salt.

Pour the sauce into the same pot used to cook the pasta. Bring to a boil. Add the pasta and toss to coat it well with the sauce. Add the reserved pasta cooking water to thin out the sauce as needed. Stir in the brown butter. Adjust the seasoning.
Serve the pasta in shallow bowls. Top with the ricotta and toasted almonds. Serve immediately.

11467.title: Squash Gratin with Sage and Parmesan
instructions: Place the rack in the middle position. Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Butter a 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9 inch) baking dish that holds about 2 litres (8 cups).
In a saucepan, bring the cream and broth to a boil with the garlic and 12 sage leaves. Reduce by one third. Add the Parmesan and stir until melted. Salt and pepper. Set aside.
Arrange the squash slices upright in the dish and tuck the remaining sage leaves between the slices. Salt and pepper.

Strain the cream mixture through a sieve set over the dish with the squash, pressing on the garlic cloves with the back of a spoon. Compost the sage leaves. Cover the pan with aluminum foil. Bake for 1 hour or until the squash slices are cooked through and tender.

Remove the aluminum foil. Continue cooking under the broiler for 3 to 5 minutes or until the squash is golden brown. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving. The perfect side for a roast, a braise or Sunday chicken.

11468.title: Minh Phat Tu's Thai Basil Stir-Fried Eggplant
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the oyster sauce, sugar, soy sauce, fish sauce and vinegar. Set aside.

In a large non-stick skillet over high heat, soften the onion, garlic and chili pepper in the oil for 2 minutes or until they start to brown. Add half the eggplant sticks and continue cooking for 5 minutes or until tender and golden, stirring during cooking. Set aside on a plate. Cook the remaining eggplant, adding oil as needed. Set aside on the plate.
Add the reserved sauce to the same skillet. Bring to a boil. Return the eggplant to the skillet and stir to coat it well with the sauce.
Spread the eggplant on a serving plate. Sprinkle with the basil leaves and serve.

11469.title: Minh Phat Tu's Shrimp-Stuffed Eggplant
instructions: Eggplant: In a food processor, chop the shrimp with the garlic, salt, white pepper and chili flakes until smooth.
On a work surface, cut the eggplants on the diagonal into long slices about 1 cm (1/2 inch) thick. Spread about 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the shrimp filling on each slice.

In a large skillet over medium-low heat, heat the oil. Add the stuffed eggplant, shrimp side down. Cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes. Gently turn the eggplant over. Cover and continue cooking for 5 to 6 minutes or until the eggplant is tender and golden and the shrimp is cooked through.
Sauce: In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch in 60 ml (1/4 cup) of the water.

In a small saucepan, combine the remaining water, sugar, vinegar, fish sauce, soy sauce, garlic and chili flakes. Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes or until the sugar has dissolved. Add the cornstarch mixture to the sauce. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly and scraping the bottom and sides of the saucepan, until the sauce thickens slightly. Remove from the heat.
Pour the sauce into the skillet with the stuffed eggplant. Stir gently to coat well with the sauce.
Arrange the eggplant in a serving bowl. Serve immediately.

11470.title: Milk Chocolate “Little Monster” Truffles
instructions: Truffles: Place the chocolate in a bowl.
In a small pot, bring the cream to a boil. Pour the hot cream over the chocolate. Let sit for 2 minutes without stirring. Whisk until the ganache is smooth. Stir in the butter. Add the candy and mix.

Transfer 30 ml (2 tbsp) of the ganache to a piping bag fitted with a small plain tip or to a freezer bag. Set aside at room temperature. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 1 hour 30 minutes or leave at room temperature for 3 hours, until firm but pliable.
Line a baking sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper.
Using a 1-tbsp (15 ml) ice cream scoop, shape the ganache into balls. Finish rolling them quickly with your hands. Place the truffles on the baking sheet.

Assembly: Divide the sprinkles among small plates (one colour per plate). Roll the truffles in the sprinkles. Attach the candy eyes to the truffles using the reserved truffle mixture. The truffles keep for 2 weeks in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

11471.title: Caramel Popcorn Cookies
instructions: Cookies: In a bowl, combine the flour, baking soda and salt.

In another bowl, cream the butter with the brown sugar and sugar for 2 minutes using an electric mixer. Add the eggs one at a time and mix for 1 minute. With the machine running on low speed, stir in the dry ingredients. With a wooden spoon, stir in 90 g (2 ½ cups) of the caramel popcorn.

Using a 3-tbsp (45 ml) ice cream scoop, shape the mixture into balls and space them out on a baking sheet lined with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Spread the remaining caramel popcorn over the balls of dough, pressing lightly. Refrigerate for 2 hours or freeze at this point, if desired (see notes).

Caramel: Meanwhile, in a pot, bring the sugar and water to a boil. Cook without stirring until an amber caramel forms. Remove from the heat. Gradually add the cream. Watch out for splattering. Bring back to a boil and cook, stirring, until the mixture is smooth and a thermometer reads 108 °C (226 °F). Remove from the heat. Stir in the butter and fleur de sel. Let cool.
Place the rack in the middle position. Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line two baking sheets with silicone mats or parchment paper. Place 7 cookies on each baking sheet, spacing them apart.
Bake one sheet at a time for 12 minutes or until the cookies are lightly golden around the edges but still very soft in the centre, rotating the sheet halfway through.
Using the back of a tablespoon, make a hollow in the centre of each cookie and fill it with caramel, about 10 ml (2 tsp) per hollow. Let cool on the baking sheet.

instructions.0: Rice Pudding: In a large saucepan over medium heat, bring the milk to a boil with the vanilla seeds and pod. Add the rice and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes or until the rice is very tender, stirring frequently. Stir in the sugar and continue cooking for 2 minutes.
instructions.1: Spread the rice in a dish. Cover the surface of the rice directly with plastic wrap. Let cool slightly and refrigerate for 4 hours or until the rice pudding is completely cooled.
instructions.2: When ready to serve, stir the rice pudding with a spatula to loosen it. Add milk to thin it, as needed.
instructions.3: Assembly: Using a zester, grate the lime to collect the zest.
instructions.4: On a work surface, cut off both ends of the lime and stand it flat. Cut away the peel as close to the flesh as possible, leaving no white pith. Slide the knife blade between each membrane to release the segments and collect the juice. Compost the peels and membranes. Cut each segment into 4 pieces.
instructions.5: Divide the rice pudding among bowls. Sprinkle with the lime zest. Top with the lime pieces, raspberries and raspberry powder.
